label: Transport of the product control gives every interior mass on countable carriers (inference)
rule: Push the Bernoulli-geometric product forward along a fiber-preserving surjection
meaning: Surjections from Nat onto the nonempty event and onto its nonempty complement give a surjection from Bool x Nat sending the true fiber into the event and the false fiber into its complement. The pushforward of the product control at interior p is a probability with positive mass at every point and event mass p.
